label: Flow 1: Sensor Data → InfluxDB
info: Subscribes to hivis/+/data, parses JSON, writes air_quality measurement to InfluxDB.

label: Flow 2: Device Registration
info: Handles hivis/register, checks whitelist, generates credentials, publishes to hivis/provision/[mac].

label: Flow 3: System Status
info: Subscribes to hivis/+/data, extracts system fields, writes device_status measurement to InfluxDB.
